mapper.select: SELECT cardNo, sno, sname, type, college, major, birth, originPlace, cardStatus, times FROM libcard WHERE cardNo = #{cardNo}
SELECT cardNo, sno, sname, type, college, major, birth, originPlace, cardStatus, times FROM libcard WHERE sno = #{sno} AND cardStatus = '正常' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM libcard WHERE sno = #{sno} AND cardStatus = '挂失'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM libcard WHERE sno = #{sno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO libcard (cardNo, sno, sname, type, college, major, birth, originPlace, cardStatus, times) VALUES (#{cardNo}, #{sno}, #{sname}, #{type}, #{college}, #{major}, #{birth}, #{originPlace}, #{cardStatus}, #{times})
mapper.update: UPDATE libcard SET cardStatus = #{cardStatus} WHERE cardNo = #{cardNo}
